text: Marcus wires the CI/CD pipeline to a real Kubernetes rollout across the dev, staging, and prod namespaces on EKS.
Both services deploy with a rolling-update strategy and readiness probes, so capacity never drops during a deploy.
Promotion from dev to staging is automatic once a smoke check passes; staging to prod waits on a required human approval.
Marcus runs a real version bump through all three namespaces end to end -- it completes cleanly with no rollback needed.
Next: centralized logging for catalog-api and checkout-api.
